question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.
sql:
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        f.film_id,
        f.title,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_revenue
    FROM film f
    JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id
    JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
    JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        a.actor_id,
        a.first_name,
        a.last_name,
        fr.film_id,
        fr.title,
        fr.total_revenue,
        fr.total_revenue / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fa2.actor_id) FROM film_actor fa2 WHERE fa2.film_id = fr.film_id) as revenue_per_actor
    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id
    JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
),
ranked_films AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        film_id,
        title,
        revenue_per_actor,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY revenue_per_actor DESC) as rn
    FROM actor_film_revenue
)
SELECT 
    first_name,
    last_name,
    film_id,
    title,
    revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked_films
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY actor_id, revenue_per_actor DESC

```sql
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        f.film_id,
        f.title,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_revenue
    FROM film f
    JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id
    JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
    JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        a.actor_id,
        a.first_name,
        a.last_name,
        fr.film_id,
        fr.title,
        fr.total_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fa2.actor_id) as num_actors_in_film,
        fr.total_revenue / COUNT(DISTINCT fa2.actor_id) as revenue_per_actor
    FROM actor_film_revenue fr
    JOIN film_actor fa2 ON fr.film_id = fa2.film_id
    JOIN actor a ON fa2.actor_id = a.actor_id
    GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name, fr.film_id, fr.title, fr.total_revenue
),
ranked_films AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        film_id,
        title,
        revenue_per_actor,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY revenue_per_actor DESC) as rn
    FROM actor_film_revenue
)
SELECT 
    first_name,
    last_name,
    film_id,
    title,
    revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked_films
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY actor_id, revenue_per_actor DESC
```
